name: gh-prs-monitor
description: Your GitHub pull requests inside Claude Code: what needs you first, each linked to its ticket, alerts when something changes, one-press merge, update branch and re-run CI, and skills that resolve comments, fix CI, resolve conflicts, review and create pull requests

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: background: check from session start, with alerts and the summary. while-open: check only while the /prs pane is open. on-demand: check only when /prs runs, Refresh or Retry is pressed, after a row's button, and once when a session starts, or /clear or a resume starts a new conversation, with the pane open and no list in it

pollMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often pull requests are checked in background and while-open modes, up to 1440 (a day)

shareRefresh.title: Share refreshes between sessions
shareRefresh.description: Sessions in the same repository take turns asking GitHub and share its answers, so the timers ask GitHub about once per interval, in every app alike; opening the pane, Refresh, /prs, a button's action and a skill's turns always ask GitHub; off, each session asks for itself

notify.title: Change alerts
notify.description: Show what changed on your pull requests and reviews: as alerts, as a note on each changed row in the pane, and in the list /prs prints where no pane shows; the alert rows below pick which kinds

alertSeconds.title: Alert duration (seconds)
alertSeconds.description: How long an alert stays up; hovering keeps it, a click dismisses it

recentChangesExpiryMinutes.title: Recent changes expire after (minutes)
recentChangesExpiryMinutes.description: How long the note of what changed stays at the foot of a pull request in the pane, and its dot in the compact view, from when a refresh noticed it; its ✕, one of its buttons or closing the pane clears it sooner

holdWhileWorking.title: Hold alerts while working
holdWhileWorking.description: Keep alerts back while a turn runs, and show them when it finishes, so they don't cover what you are reading

alertSound.title: Alert sound
alertSound.description: Play a short sound with alerts; macOS only, as Linux and Windows terminals have no player

systemNotification.title: Alerts as system notifications
systemNotification.description: Also send your alerts about pull request changes as system notifications, the way Claude Code sends its own: a banner in iTerm2, kitty or Ghostty, or in another terminal once Claude Code's notification channel is set for it. Follows Change alerts and the Alert rows; terminal only; needs Claude Code 2.1.295

alertReady.title: Alert: ready to merge
alertReady.description: One of your pull requests can merge: approved, checks green, nothing blocking

alertComments.title: Alert: comments
alertComments.description: New comments in your pull requests' conversations; those on the diff come with their review

alertReviews.title: Alert: reviews
alertReviews.description: Approvals, change requests and reviews on your pull requests

alertCi.title: Alert: CI
alertCi.description: Checks on your pull requests failing, or passing after running

alertConflicts.title: Alert: conflicts
alertConflicts.description: New merge conflicts on your pull requests

alertReviewRequests.title: Alert: review requests
alertReviewRequests.description: Being asked to review a pull request, including being asked again

alertNewCommits.title: Alert: new commits
alertNewCommits.description: New commits on pull requests you reviewed without approving

alertMentions.title: Alert: mentions
alertMentions.description: Someone mentions you on another person's open pull request

alertClosed.title: Alert: merged and closed
alertClosed.description: Your pull requests, and the ones on your review list, merged or closed by someone else

statusLine.title: Status line summary
statusLine.description: Count what needs you in the status line, or in a band above the prompt in the desktop app; with background refresh only, as nothing else keeps it current

includeOutdated.title: Count outdated comments
includeOutdated.description: Count unresolved review comments on code that has since changed, and let Resolve Comments work on them too

hideDrafts.title: Hide drafts
hideDrafts.description: Leave your own draft pull requests out of the pane, its counts and the list /prs prints; a line says how many are hidden. Drafts you are asked to review still show

showTickets.title: Ticket links on rows
showTickets.description: Show each pull request's ticket on its row, as a link, in repositories with ticket links set up (/prs tickets); off, only the skills use them

cleanupWorktrees.title: Clean up worktrees and branches
cleanupWorktrees.description: Remove the worktrees Resolve Comments, Fix CI and Resolve Conflicts made, their local branches, and the pr-<number> branches Here, switch branch left while they still track their pull request, once it is merged or closed and nothing would be lost: no uncommitted changes, every commit on GitHub, no ignored file the main checkout lacks or holds otherwise
